facts.fact: 周一早晨眼睛干涩地去农场
facts.anchor: By the time Gazzie and I left for the farm Monday morning, my eyes were bone-dry

facts.fact: 周三傍晚 Harrison 不请自来
facts.anchor: that Wednesday evening, when the sun hovered above the house across the street, Harrison showed up unannounced
“What are you doing here?” I asked, hands going to my hair
“Checking on you,” he said
he inclined his head toward his car. “Want to go for a drive?”
his hand letting go of mine several steps later than necessary
he unearthed a plastic snack bag containing two jumbo marshmallows. He held one out
an alligator emerged from the water and snapped it up
I took a marshmallow from his hand and, winding my arm back, tossed it
three alligators surfaced and streamlined toward it, multiple jaws flashing

facts.fact: 她讲出 Nova 的警告：去问 Leon 怎么死的
facts.anchor: I told him about Nova’s warning, how she said I needed to ask how Uncle Leon died
“Yeah,” he said. “I know about that.”
“I had a rough childhood.”

facts.fact: 揪 Michelle 的辫子、她磕到黑板沿
facts.anchor: she hit her head on the outdoor chalkboard’s wooden ledge
Eyes fluttering shut, she went rag-doll limp

facts.fact: 「我妈看见我打 Michelle，把我拉开」
facts.anchor: “My mother saw me hit Michelle,” I said quickly. “She pulled me off her.”

facts.fact: 母亲谎称 Michelle 自己摔倒、叫了救护车
facts.anchor: she’d seen Michelle trip over her own feet
they called the ambulance. I got away with it.
“My mother pulled me out of school,” I said

facts.fact: 数月后的新闻：Michelle 溺亡于 Savannah River
facts.anchor: a news report said she’d drowned herself in the Savannah River

facts.fact: Harrison 搂她入怀、说母亲错了
facts.anchor: Suddenly, Harrison was pulling me into his arms. “Your mother was wrong to tell you that,” he said, breath hot on my forehead. “You were just a kid.”
“I came to say you deserve it.”
“The inheritance. All of it.”
“Gators,” he explained, cocking his head
a half-submerged alligator lifted itself another inch above the water and growled again
“It’s a mating call,” he explained
Slowly, gently, he pressed his lips to mine
